FDA FOOD CODE (FIXTURE EXCERPT)

3-501.16 Time/Temperature Control for Safety Food, Hot and Cold Holding.

Time/temperature control for safety food shall be maintained at 135 degrees F or above, or at 41 degrees F or less. The danger zone is the range between 41 degrees F and 135 degrees F, where bacteria multiply fastest.

3-401.11 Cooking Raw Animal Foods.

Poultry must be cooked to an internal temperature of 165 degrees F for 15 seconds. Ground beef must reach 155 degrees F for 17 seconds. Whole muscle beef steaks must reach 145 degrees F for 15 seconds.
